title: Prestige and Ascension in Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker
subtitle: What each reset gives you, and when to press it.
description: How prestige works in Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker, levels, milestones, Ascension, Quantum Shards and when to reset your run for bigger permanent multipliers.
card: A clear explanation of prestige levels, milestones, Ascension and Quantum Shards in Crypto Mining: Idle Clicker.

faq.q: What do I lose when I prestige?
faq.a: Prestige resets your coins and upgrades and gives permanent prestige levels and a multiplier in return. Active boosts you paid for, your energy plants, managers and research carry on through the reset.

faq.q: What do I need for my first Ascension?
faq.a: You need at least 10 prestige levels. Each further Ascension asks for 3 more prestige levels, and at higher Ascension levels extra gates such as completed challenges or plant level-ups apply.

faq.q: Can I undo my shard upgrades?
faq.a: Yes. You can respec your shard upgrades: the game refunds every Quantum Shard you spent, and you pay a fee in coins to do it.
